items.label: Daily Drawdown Limit
items.detail: Of previous day's closing balance. Resets daily at 17:00 NY Time.

items.label: Max Overall Drawdown
items.detail: Of initial balance. Static for lifetime of account. Hard breach on violation.

items.label: Floating DD Warning
items.detail: Early warning notification at 1.0% floating loss per symbol. No consequence.

items.label: Floating DD Breach
items.detail: First breach = formal warning (no strike). Second breach onwards = Soft Breach (strike). Per symbol, net combined open positions.

items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: Instant funding — no evaluation, no profit target.

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: No consistency requirement for this account type.

items.label: Notional Volume
items.detail: Limit varies by account size. Breach = Soft Breach (strike).

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: Weekend holding requires purchasing the Weekend Holding Add-On. Without it = strike.

items.label: Strike Sources
items.value: Notional volume, weekend hold, floating DD
items.detail: Strikes cumulative across all rules. Example: 1 from each = 3 total strikes.

items.label: Per Strike
items.detail: Each strike reduces next payout cycle by 10%.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Daily or max drawdown violation = instant termination.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: On-demand after 5 minimum profitable days are completed, then every 14 days.

items.label: Min Profitable Days
items.detail: Must complete 5 profitable days per 14-day cycle before each payout.
